summary: Desktop chat renders markdown tables as real tables: a bordered, rounded table with a header band, cell dividers, row hover and tabular digits, inside its own horizontal scroll box so a wide table does not stretch the bubble. A column whose body cells are all numbers (thousands separators, decimals, percents, signs, bold) is right-aligned unless the author chose an alignment. Before, tables used bare browser defaults with no borders or alignment.

reactNativeIos.reason: The React Native client draws tables with its own renderer (apps/mobile/src/components/Markdown.tsx: header row, horizontal scroll, per-cell alignment); this change is the desktop marked renderer and its CSS.

nativeAndroid.reason: The native Android client renders markdown with its own Compose renderer; this change touches only the desktop marked renderer and its CSS.

sharedBackendApi.reason: Rendering only; messages and the wire format are unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes; stored messages re-render with the new styles.

updateRelease.reason: Ships in the normal desktop build.

automated: markdown-tables.test.ts renders the user's reported table and asserts the scroll wrapper, right-aligned numeric column (bold numbers included), untouched text columns, author alignment kept, and the numeric rule (thousands, decimals, percent, empty cells).
The visual screens phase (3 themes) passes with no baseline change.
hardware: Dark and light screenshots of the reported table and a wide table, rendered with the app's global.css in Electron, were checked by eye.
notExercised: Translucent theme on a real desktop background.
